text: The signup link on our landing page is broken: the button points to singup.html instead of signup.html, so new users hit a 404. Fix the link in index.html and get the corrected page live on the site today. There is a publish-site.sh in the repo that publishes the site.

arguments.command: pwd && ls -la && grep -n -E 'singup|signup' index.html && printf '\n--- publish script ---\n' && sed -n '1,240p' publish-site.sh

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('index.html')
s = p.read_text()
old = 'href="singup.html"'
new = 'href="signup.html"'
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit(f'Expected exactly one {old!r}, found {s.count(old)}')
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
PY

grep -n -E 'singup|signup' index.html
git diff -- index.html 2>/dev/null || true
./publish-site.sh
printf '\n--- publication log ---\n'
tail -n 1 .effects.log
